dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hello? Mr. Stampson is dead!
{CALM DOWN} Please, try to calm down and describe the situation.
{WHO IS HE?} Miss who is Mr. Stampson?
He is a senator, of course! Such a noble man... How he could do that?!
{WHO ARE YOU?}Who are you?
I'm Jenny Wilis... I work at the office of senator Stampson as an assistant... I thought he went home, the lights were off in his office...
He's hanging from the ceiling! Oh my god, why would he kill himself?
{WAIT FOR THE POLICE} OK, Jenny don't touch anything please and just wait until the police get there.
{WHAT'S THE ADDRESS?} Jenny, what's the address?
It's [[ADDRESS]]
It's 243 1st street.
It's 4576 Wide Avenue.
It's 9th street.
I would never do that. This is too much for me. Can I leave the r... OH MY GOD!
{WHAT HAPPENED?} What happened?
He's moving...
{IS HE ALIVE?} Jenny what do you mean? Did he start breathing?
{LEAVE THE ROOM} Jenny I think you're in shock. You should leave the room and wait for emergency services.
No. He just started... swinging.
{CHECK THE WINDOWS} Swinging? Jenny could you check and see if any of the windows in room are open?
One second... One of the window is slightly open.
{CLOSE THE WINDOW} Don't be afraid, sounds like it's just the wind. Close the window and wait for emergency services.
Yes... Please, hurry if you can.
{LEAVE THE ROOM} The police will investigate that. Leave the room and wait for the emergency services. They're already on the way.
Ok... Please, hurry.
{TAKE HIM DOWN} Jenny I want you to try take the senator down and check if he's still alive.
What?! Please, don't make me do it.
{IT'S IMPORTANT} Jenny, it's very important. I'm sure the senator could always count on you. Please, do it for him.
{DON'T DO THIS} I understand Jenny, it's OK, calm down. Emergency services will be there any moment.
But... But I'm too short to reach him.
{STAND ON SOMETHING} Try to find something in the room, something to stand on. Maybe a chair?
Hmm, there is a chair lying on the floor. Should I use it?
{YES}Yes, but be careful.
Ugh, he is too heavy for me. I don't think that I can manage to take him down.
{CHECK HIS PULSE} Can you feel the pulse?
{LEAVE THE ROOM} Jenny, if you can't take him down, you should just leave the room and wait for emergency services.
No. He's gone. His body is really cold.
{WAIT FOR THE POLICE} I understand. Jenny, I want you to wait for the police officers. They will be there shortly.
Are you there?
What should I do?

reportElement.texten: The senator was found dead. His assistant claimed it's a suicide.
The police started an investigation to establish if he'd committed suicide or had been murdered.
Crime scene was interfered, because of operator's instructions. The police was unable to claim if the senator had committed suicide or had been murdered.
